tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are a student who recently borrowed a book from the university library. Unfortunately, you accidentally damaged the book. You want to inform the librarian, Mr. Anderson, about the incident and inquire about the steps you need to take to resolve the situation. Write an email to Mr. Anderson.
bullets: Describe the incident that caused the book damage and the extent of the damage to the book.
Explain your concern about the consequences for damaging the book.
Ask about the steps you should take to resolve the situation.
tasks.subject: Damaged library book
